200 Returns the details of the specified managed credential object.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The name of the managed credential object. You specify the name when
you create or update the managed credential.
string
The definition of the managed credential object. You specify the
description when you create or update the managed credential.
object
object
boolean
A value specifying how a user creates a managed credential in the user
interface. If true , the user created the credential during the scan
configuration. If false , the user created the credential independently
from scan configuration.
integer
The permissions for the managed credential that are assigned to the
user account submitting the API request. For possible values, see
"Credential Roles" in Permissions.
uuid
required
name
description
category
type
ad_hoc
user_permissions
object
The configuration settings for the credential. The parameters of this
object vary depending on the credential type. For more information, see
Determine Settings for a Credential Type.
Array of objects
— 403
Returned if you do not have sufficient permissions to view the specified managed credential object.
— 404
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find a managed credential object with the
specified UUID.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 503
Returned if a Tenable Vulnerability Management service is unavailable. Wait a moment, and try your
request again.
— 504
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management is unavailable. Wait a moment, and try your request
again.
